January 20, 1971
2014-11-23T00:01:12+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/january-20-1971-53725

Today is the fourth day of 11-point demand. On this occasion East Pakistan Chhatra Union and East Pakistan Chhatra League separately observes full strike at all educational institutions in town.

President Yahya Khan arrives in Rawalpindi in the morning after a five-day stay in Karachi.

Punjab Council Muslim League President Sardar Shawkat Hayan Kha meet with President Yahya Khan at the president’s residence.
